en: A color postcard showing a large modernist building with dark glass and concrete, characterized by a polygonal upper volume with sloping curtain walls and a broad, stepped base. People walk across an open paved plaza in the foreground, where numerous national flags are displayed on poles. On the roof terrace of the building are rows of sun loungers and umbrellas with several people relaxing. The architecture suggests a conference or cultural center from the late 20th century in an urban setting.
